stories.title: Itaipu studies up to 1 GW of solar to support Paraguay’s power grid
stories.description: Simulations of PV plants connected at three points in Paraguay’s electricity network found that specialized controls could dampen inter-area power oscillations, while the study also recommends battery storage to improve system response.

stories.title: Portugal makes grid-forming mandatory for large battery storage plants
stories.description: Portugal has set new grid connection rules for energy storage, moving ahead of the EU’s own revision of generator connection requirements.

stories.title: "No human at the helm": Delaware plan would let AI agents run entire businesses
stories.description: Owners of AI-run firms would evade liability for "reckless" AI, US Rep.

stories.title: Vibe genes? Natural(ish) language comes to protein, genome design software
stories.description: You can apparently now tell AI tools what sort of protein you want them to make.

stories.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
stories.description: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

stories.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
stories.description: The manufacturing accelerator bills itself as "America’s answer to Shenzhen."

stories.title: Energy bill help, minimum wage rise and bank taxes - what could be in the Budget?
stories.description: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

stories.title: Netanyahu and Eisenkot face difficult paths to power as neither set to win majority
stories.description: The two main blocs appear to have too few seats to form the next government without reliance on Arab parties.

stories.title: Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World
stories.description: arXiv:2610.36618v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget.

stories.title: HeteGCD: Statistics-Aware Dual-Prototype Learning for Generalized Category Discovery on Heterophilous Graphs
stories.description: arXiv:2610.36696v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Heterophilous graphs are prevalent in real-world applications, where connected nodes often exhibit dissimilar attributes or belong to different classes, posing significant challenges to conventional graph learning methods based on homophily.

stories.title: New flywheel design could eliminate power converter for grid connection
stories.description: A research team has built a fixed-speed flywheel prototype that uses a wire-rope mechanism to move weights inward and outward during discharge and charge. The system briefly supplied power to the electrical supply, but steady-state losses prevented net electrical energy discharge over the complete operation.

stories.title: BoLT: A Benchmark to Democratize Black-box Optimization Research for Expensive LLM Tasks
stories.description: arXiv:2605.17000v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Optimization of LLM training and inference configurations, such as hyperparameters, data mixtures, and prompts, is critical to performance, but it is often approached heuristically in practice, leading to potentially suboptimal outcomes.
